missionText.briefing:
We have entered hostile waters, destroy
everything that shoots!

You'll be leading some squadrons into the 
enemy bay. 

Try to catch the basterds sleeping...
missionText.success:
Congratulations! You are very impressive!
We ask you to do a pinpoint mission.
missionText.failure: Use your invisibilities and your a-bomb.
